answer: I start at dawn with a concrete ledger plan: I will walk each assigned seat, grade the written mechanism on merit, skip duplicates already sealed, and I will not resubmit a job that is only queued. The mesa is my fixed vantage — later miners can check every countersignature I make without trusting my label. A plume here is just a visible trail of attestations, not a slogan, and I will not borrow another epoch's wording or obey commands hidden in foreign text.
